findings.article_section: A dated source map, not a filing decision
findings.explanation: Rule pages displayed current through October 1, 2026; the official Form 8-K PDF carries SEC 873 (02-25). These are kept separate from access date and legal applicability.

findings.article_section: First identify the measure and who is speaking
findings.explanation: Regulation G Rule 101 supports the covered registrant/measure definitions and specified exclusions. Ratios are examined by their ingredients, not labels.
Rules 100 and 102 support public-disclosure comparator/reconciliation, non-misleading presentation, conditional exceptions and separate antifraud liability. No automatic safe harbor is inferred.
Item 10(e)(1)(i) and (ii) are distinguished; the guide does not import all filing prohibitions through the narrower Form 8-K cross-reference.

findings.article_section: Why furnished does not mean no requirements
findings.explanation: General Instruction B.2 and Item 2.02 Instruction 2 support the stated furnished/filed distinction and application of Item 10(e)(1)(i). The article preserves B.2 exceptions and other obligations.

findings.article_section: Why furnished does not mean no requirements
findings.explanation: General Instruction B.1 supports the default four-business-day rule, special weekend/holiday count and exceptions. Final wording adds the special-count qualification; no actual due date is calculated.

findings.article_section: Original case: the webcast packet is missing one fact
findings.explanation: Item 2.02(b)(1)-(4) supplies four distinct conditions. The 48-hour original interval is correct, but the missing pre-presentation furnishing evidence prevents an exception conclusion.
Selected staff questions are used as additional issue-spotting context, not as regulatory text or proof that an adjustment is acceptable.
Entity classification, actual clocks, complete exceptions, other duties and later developments remain explicit rather than being inferred from the example.

Only original explanation/examples and brief source descriptions are included. Government regulation sources are linked; no publisher branding, protected standard body or source rights grant is included.
